yearCorrection.reason: 英文维基正文指出此战年代自古不明：李维系于公元前499年，狄奥尼修斯等作前496年，现代学者另有前493、前489年之说；维基数据 P585 精度为年代（前490年代）。本条采用正文最常引用的前496年（记作 −496）。

entries.summaryZh: 勒吉鲁斯湖战役是罗马共和国初年罗马对阵拉丁同盟的一场交战，传统上系于公元前496年前后，带有浓厚传说色彩。流亡的末代国王塔克文·苏佩布与其婿、图斯库卢姆独裁官奥克塔维乌斯·马米利乌斯率拉丁军试图复辟，被罗马独裁官波斯图米乌斯击退。传说卡斯托尔与波吕克斯曾助战罗马一方。
entries.summaryEn: The battle of Lake Regillus was a legendary Roman victory over the Latin League shortly after the republic was founded. The Latins, led by the exiled king Lucius Tarquinius Superbus and his son-in-law Octavius Mamilius, marched to restore the Tarquins; the Romans under the dictator Aulus Postumius defeated them. Legend has Castor and Pollux fighting on the Roman side.
entries.significanceZh: 它被视为塔克文家族复辟企图的终结，也是罗马共和国早期对拉丁同盟确立优势的标志性战役。
entries.significanceEn: It ended the Tarquins' attempt to reclaim the throne and became the founding military legend of the early Roman Republic.
entries.notesZh: 断代：维基数据 P585 为 ISO 天文纪年 −496（精度为年代，即前490年代）；英文维基正文指出此战年代自古不明，李维系于公元前499年，狄奥尼修斯等作前496年，现代学者另有前493、前489年之说，本条采用前496年（记作 −496）并保留全部异说。中文维基百科尚无该条目。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录，本次升级未改动。
entries.notesEn: Dating: Wikidata P585 is the ISO astronomical year -496 at decade precision; the English article states that the year has been unclear since antiquity - Livy gives 499 BC, Dionysius and others 496 BC, and some modern authors 493 or 489 BC. The entry adopts 496 BC (written -496) and records all variants. The Chinese Wikipedia has no article for this event. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.

entries.summaryZh: 克朗塔夫战役发生于1014年4月23日，地点在都柏林附近的克朗塔夫，是爱尔兰高王布赖恩·博鲁与都柏林国王西特里格、伦斯特国王梅尔·莫尔达及外来维京军队的决战。战斗自日出持续至日落，维京与伦斯特联军溃败，阵亡者估计7000至10000人。布赖恩本人及其子、孙均在战后被杀。
entries.summaryEn: The battle of Clontarf was fought on 23 April 1014 at Clontarf near Dublin. Brian Boru, High King of Ireland, faced a Norse-Irish alliance of Sigtrygg Silkbeard of Dublin, Mael Morda of Leinster and Viking forces from abroad. The fighting lasted from sunrise to sunset and ended in a rout; between 7,000 and 10,000 men were killed, including Brian himself.
entries.significanceZh: 此役遏止了维京势力在爱尔兰的扩张，但布赖恩之死使其家族未能建立统一的王权。
entries.significanceEn: It broke Viking power in Ireland, though Brian's death prevented his family from consolidating a unified Irish kingship.
entries.notesZh: 断代：维基数据 P585 为1014年4月23日，与英文维基正文一致，条目采用年精度。中文维基百科尚无该条目；本条目据英文维基百科与维基数据实体撰写。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录，本次升级未改动。
entries.notesEn: Dating: Wikidata P585 records 23 April 1014, matching the English article, and the entry keeps year precision. The Chinese Wikipedia has no article for this event; the entry is written from the English article and the Wikidata entity. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.

entries.summaryZh: 迈尔季欧云之战发生于1179年6月，地点在利塔尼河附近的迈尔季欧云（今黎巴嫩境内），是耶路撒冷王国与萨拉丁统率的阿尤布军队之间的交战。萨拉丁取得决定性胜利，被视为其对抗十字军的一系列胜利的开端。患麻风病的国王鲍德温四世由卫队救出，侥幸未被俘。
entries.summaryEn: The battle of Marj Ayyun was fought in June 1179 near the Litani River in modern Lebanon between the Kingdom of Jerusalem under Baldwin IV and the Ayyubid army of Saladin. It ended in a decisive Muslim victory, the first of Saladin's long run of successes against the Crusader states, though the leper king Baldwin narrowly escaped capture.
entries.significanceZh: 它是萨拉丁对十字军国家一连串胜利的开端，改变了耶路撒冷王国北部边境的态势。
entries.significanceEn: It opened Saladin's series of victories over the Crusader states and shifted the balance on Jerusalem's northern frontier.
entries.notesZh: 断代：维基数据 P585 为1179年6月10日，与英文维基正文所记6月一致，条目采用年精度。中文维基百科尚无该条目；本条目据英文维基百科与维基数据实体撰写。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录。
entries.notesEn: Dating: Wikidata P585 records 10 June 1179, matching the June date given by the English article, and the entry keeps year precision. The Chinese Wikipedia has no article for this event; the entry is written from the English article and the Wikidata entity. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.

entries.summaryZh: 大马士革围城战自634年8月21日持续至9月19日，以城市向拉希敦哈里发国投降告终。大马士革是穆斯林征服叙利亚过程中陷落的第一座东罗马帝国重镇。此前哈里发阿布·伯克尔于634年4月入侵黎凡特，并在阿杰纳代因战役中击败拜占庭军队。
entries.summaryEn: The siege of Damascus lasted from 21 August to 19 September 634 and ended with the city's surrender to the Rashidun Caliphate. Damascus was the first major Eastern Roman city to fall in the Muslim conquest of Syria, after Caliph Abu Bakr invaded the Levant in April 634 and defeated a Byzantine army at Ajnadayn.
entries.significanceZh: 作为穆斯林征服叙利亚攻下的第一座大城，它为此后黎凡特战事打开了门户。
entries.significanceEn: As the first major city taken in the Muslim conquest of Syria, it opened the Levant to the advancing caliphate.
entries.notesZh: 断代：维基数据 P585 为634年（年精度），与英文维基正文所记围城起止（8月21日至9月19日）一致，条目采用年精度。中文维基百科尚无该条目；本条目据英文维基百科与维基数据实体撰写。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录。
entries.notesEn: Dating: Wikidata P585 records 634 at year precision, consistent with the English article's siege dates of 21 August to 19 September, and the entry keeps year precision. The Chinese Wikipedia has no article for this event; the entry is written from the English article and the Wikidata entity. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.

entries.summaryZh: 卢格杜努姆战役发生于197年2月19日，地点在今法国里昂，是罗马皇帝塞普蒂米乌斯·塞维鲁与篡位者克洛狄乌斯·阿尔比努斯之间的决战。塞维鲁获胜，成为罗马帝国唯一的皇帝，结束了五帝之年的余波。此役被认为是罗马军队之间规模最大、最惨烈的交战之一。
entries.summaryEn: The battle of Lugdunum was fought on 19 February 197 at Lugdunum, modern Lyon, between the armies of the emperor Septimius Severus and the usurper Clodius Albinus. Severus' victory made him sole emperor after the Year of the Five Emperors. It is described as one of the largest and bloodiest clashes between Roman forces.
entries.significanceZh: 塞维鲁的胜利终结了帝位争夺，开启了塞维鲁王朝对帝国的统治。
entries.significanceEn: Severus' victory ended the contest for the throne and inaugurated the Severan dynasty's rule over the empire.
entries.notesZh: 断代：维基数据 P585 为197年2月19日，与英文维基正文一致，条目采用年精度。中文维基百科尚无该条目；本条目据英文维基百科与维基数据实体撰写。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录，本次升级未改动。
entries.notesEn: Dating: Wikidata P585 records 19 February 197, matching the English article, and the entry keeps year precision. The Chinese Wikipedia has no article for this event; the entry is written from the English article and the Wikidata entity. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.

entries.summaryZh: 克雷森之战发生于1187年5月1日，是法兰克人与埃及阿尤布军队在拿撒勒附近「克雷森泉」发生的一次小规模交战。该泉的确切位置至今不明，仅知位于拿撒勒周边地区，战场位置因而无法确定。此役是两个月后耶路撒冷王国在哈丁战役中决定性惨败的前奏。
entries.summaryEn: The battle of Cresson was a small engagement between Frankish and Egyptian Ayyubid forces on 1 May 1187 at the Spring of the Cresson, whose exact location near Nazareth is unknown. It served as the prelude to the Kingdom of Jerusalem's decisive defeat at the Horns of Hattin two months later.
entries.significanceZh: 它被视为哈丁战役的前奏，暴露出耶路撒冷王国在野战中兵源与指挥的脆弱。
entries.significanceEn: It exposed the kingdom's weakness in the field and set up the disaster at Hattin.
entries.notesZh: 断代：维基数据 P585 为1187年5月1日，与英文维基正文一致，条目采用年精度。中文维基百科尚无该条目；本条目据英文维基百科与维基数据实体撰写。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录，本次升级未改动。
entries.notesEn: Dating: Wikidata P585 records 1 May 1187, matching the English article, and the entry keeps year precision. The Chinese Wikipedia has no article for this event; the entry is written from the English article and the Wikidata entity. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.

entries.summaryZh: 北邑战役发生于1963年1月2日，是越南战争期间南越军队及其美国顾问在定祥省北邑村对越南南方民族解放阵线武装的一次进攻。南越方面出动两个保安营和一个步兵团，并有炮兵与M113装甲车支援，却未能歼灭对手，还损失了数架直升机。
entries.summaryEn: The battle of Ap Bac was fought on 2 January 1963 in Dinh Tuong Province, South Vietnam, when government forces and their US advisers attacked a Viet Cong force at Ap Tan Thoi. Two Civil Guard battalions and infantry supported by artillery and M113 carriers failed to destroy the guerrillas and lost several helicopters.
entries.significanceZh: 此役暴露南越军队在指挥与协同上的缺陷，成为美国内部关于介入方式争论的转折点。
entries.significanceEn: The setback exposed the South Vietnamese army's command failures and became a turning point in the American debate over the war.
entries.notesZh: 断代：维基数据 P585 为1963年1月2日，与英文维基正文一致，条目采用年精度。中文维基百科尚无该条目；本条目据英文维基百科与维基数据实体撰写。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录。
entries.notesEn: Dating: Wikidata P585 records 2 January 1963, matching the English article, and the entry keeps year precision. The Chinese Wikipedia has no article for this event; the entry is written from the English article and the Wikidata entity. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.

entries.summaryZh: 安菲波利斯战役发生于公元前422年，是伯罗奔尼撒战争期间雅典与斯巴达之间的一场交战。此役是前424年斯巴达夺取安菲波利斯后一系列事件的高潮；雅典将领克里昂与斯巴达将领伯拉西达在城下交锋，两人均阵亡。次年双方签订尼基阿斯和约。
entries.summaryEn: The battle of Amphipolis was fought in 422 BC during the Peloponnesian War between Athens and Sparta, the culmination of events that began with the Spartan capture of Amphipolis in 424 BC. Both the Athenian commander Cleon and the Spartan Brasidas were killed, and the following year the two sides concluded the Peace of Nicias.
entries.significanceZh: 两位主将阵亡促成了次年尼基阿斯和约的签订，为十年战争暂划句点。
entries.significanceEn: The deaths of both commanders cleared the way for the Peace of Nicias the following year.
entries.notesZh: 断代：维基数据 P585 为 ISO 天文纪年 −422，英文维基正文记该战役发生于公元前422年，与本条的民用纪年写法 −422（即前422年）一致，条目采用年精度。中文维基百科尚无该条目。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录。
entries.notesEn: Dating: Wikidata P585 is the ISO astronomical year -422 and the English article dates the battle to 422 BC, which this entry writes as -422 under the civil-year convention; year precision is kept. The Chinese Wikipedia has no article for this event. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.

entries.summaryZh: 卡利奈孔战役发生于531年4月19日，是伊比利亚战争期间拜占庭帝国与萨珊波斯在卡利奈孔（今叙利亚拉卡附近）的交战。波斯将领阿扎雷特斯入侵叙利亚，拜占庭将领贝利撒留率军追击。拜占庭军队苦战后战败，波斯一方亦损失惨重，双方于次年议和。
entries.summaryEn: The battle of Callinicum took place on 19 April 531, the Saturday before Easter, between the Byzantine and Sasanian empires during the Iberian War. The Persian commander Azarethes invaded Syria and Belisarius pursued him to Callinicum, where the Byzantines were defeated after hard fighting; the war ended with peace the following year.
entries.significanceZh: 此役结束了伊比利亚战争阶段的战事，双方损耗巨大，为532年的和约铺路。
entries.significanceEn: It closed the fighting of the Iberian War and, with both armies exhausted, paved the way for the peace of 532.
entries.notesZh: 断代：维基数据 P585 为531年4月19日（复活节前的星期六），与英文维基正文一致，条目采用年精度。条目名称采用维基数据中文标签「卡利奈孔战役」，结构化索引原题「卡尔基斯战役」在维基数据 zh-hans 标签中亦有记录，此处保留标签用名。中文维基百科尚无该条目。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录。
entries.notesEn: Dating: Wikidata P585 records 19 April 531, the Saturday before Easter, matching the English article, and the entry keeps year precision. The title follows the Wikidata Chinese label for Callinicum; the index entry's older rendering is recorded in the zh-hans label variant. The Chinese Wikipedia has no article for this event. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.

entries.summaryZh: 第一次埃纳河战役是1914年9月协约国对撤退中的德军第一集团军（克卢克）与第二集团军（比洛）发起的追击战，属于马恩河战役之后的「向埃纳河推进」（9月6日至10月1日）。英法军队在埃纳河一线受阻，德军就地构筑阵地，西线自此转入堑壕对峙，运动战阶段结束。
entries.summaryEn: The First Battle of the Aisne was the Allied follow-up offensive against the retreating German First and Second Armies in September 1914, after the First Battle of the Marne. The advance halted on the Aisne heights, where the Germans dug in, and the Western Front settled into trench warfare, ending the war of movement.
entries.significanceZh: 此役标志着西线由运动战转入堑壕战，双方自此在埃纳河一线长期对峙。
entries.significanceEn: It turned the Western Front from mobile operations into the trench deadlock that defined the following years.
entries.notesZh: 断代：维基数据 P585 记为1914年9月28日，英文维基正文则把此役定在9月12日至15日（并记「向埃纳河推进」为9月6日至10月1日）；两者年份一致，本条采用年精度并保留日期分歧。中文维基百科尚无该条目。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录。
entries.notesEn: Dating: Wikidata P585 records 28 September 1914 while the English article dates the battle to 12-15 September (with the advance to the Aisne running from 6 September to 1 October); the year agrees and the entry keeps year precision, with the day-level difference recorded here. The Chinese Wikipedia has no article for this event. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.
